add.label: Select theme family
add.note: Selects a theme family, whose scene looks come with it (ADR-D01.49). Without family the theme follows the Windows light or dark setting, the default (ADR-D01.50). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Tune theme seeds
add.note: Writes a theme family's ranged seed knobs (tone, contrast, black level, accent hue, grid intensity); only the raw seeds move (ADR-D01.50). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Override colour token
add.note: Overrides one semantic token, for one theme family when theme is given, as a difference file with a contrast check on save (ADR-D01.50). The colour keeps its value across theme switches and is flagged as an override; a state or encoding role that differs from its shipped colour puts the non-standard colours mark on the view frame (ADR-D01.51). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Reset colour token
add.note: Resets an overridden token to its token value, for one theme family when theme is given (ADR-D01.51). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Set density preset
add.note: Selects a preset of the one density token table: compact, default or comfortable; compact ships (ADR-D01.45). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Set type scale
add.note: Selects a preset of the closed size ramps of the three type roles (ui, content, code); faces and metrics stay the same in every theme family and look, and the ramps are tuned later (ADR-D01.47). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Set motion preset
add.note: Selects a motion preset of the motion table (H-03). The engine commits before any animation, so a preset never changes state; curves are tuned in G5 (ADR-D01.55). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Set reduced motion
add.note: Turns reduced motion on or off; it is off by default, and reducing motion never changes state (ADR-D01.55). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Mount script panel
add.note: Mounts a program's declared panel at one of its declared mount points: palette entry, context action, inspector section, docked panel in a slot, free view or overlay annotation (ADR-D01.30). The panel keeps a stable id in the session store. Capabilities stay with the package's install consent (ADR-D01.32). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Unmount script panel
add.note: Removes a mounted script panel by its stable id (ADR-D01.30). The main Global and Local pair is not a script panel and stays (ADR-D01.36). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Edit radial menu
add.note: Edits a user-editable radial menu; an entry may be a command or a .6cs entry and behaves exactly like its palette row (ADR-D01.20). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Pin palette row
add.note: Pins or unpins a palette row; the palette ranks only by the solver's own recency, frequency and pins (ADR-D01.18). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Alias palette row
add.note: Sets the solver's aliases for a palette row. An alias is a synonym the palette matches and never renames the command's stable id (ADR-D01.17, ADR-D01.18). A design-profile change: it belongs to the layout history and never to the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it; layout.undo and layout.redo step it.

add.label: Set explore state
add.note: Turns the explore state on or off. While it is on, commits are paused and every view frame signals it. It may only pause commits: it never enables or makes a commit, and it changes no command vocabulary or capability (ADR-D01.39). While it is on, every commit row but layout.undo and layout.redo is refused before its token is spent, a run turns it only inside a command the solver invoked, and a restart clears it. Not in the move history (ADR-D01.14), so session.undo does not reach it.

add.label: Open preview view
add.note: Opens the preview view, a free view outside the main pair, on an identified preview: its full collateral effect, witness sequence, effect on every orbit and on protection, with a before-to-after scrub and move-by-move stepping (ADR-D01.10). The main Global and Local views keep the committed state with a pending marker. It prepares no preview and commits nothing.

add.label: Pin free view
add.note: Pins or unpins a free view, the preview view included, to the source its binding chip names: committed state, a preview, a saved reference or a history position (ADR-D01.42, ADR-D01.43). Global and Local always show the committed state (ADR-D01.40).

add.label: Compare with A/B wipe
add.note: Compares a free view's source with another binding (committed state, a preview, a saved reference or a history position) by an A/B wipe; without against the wipe ends (ADR-D01.42).

add.label: Set history dock mode
add.note: Shows the History dock as the move history in .6cs (one expandable header row per transaction) or as the plain list of named transactions (ADR-D01.15). Display only: it moves no rollback cursor.
